title: Book Three · Chapter 42: A Letter for Next Week
story:
Two weeks later, Leo's fifth reply comes in the afternoon.

Ronan reads it beside the open window. Spring is warmer now. Outside, Mum has put some work in a patch of light.

Leo has drawn a rice bag beside the first line. This one has very long legs.

Dear Ronan,

Your rice man needs these. Did you reach the field?

Ronan laughs. Leo does not know about Anna's finish yet. The fifth letter went before the running day.

He reads the next part more slowly.

Happy birthday for next week. Fifteen sounds much older than fourteen. Try to remember us young people.

Ronan looks at the words again. Fifteen. His birthday is next Thursday.

Then Leo writes about the summer holiday.

I hope to come back for a short visit. I don't have the family dates yet. I want to see your new school too. Write about the run. And tell me where I can find you in the holiday.

Ronan puts the page down. He can hear Mr Qiu outside. Near the window, Mum opens her needle case.

He pictures Leo beside Kai at the field. Both will want the ball. Anna may be on the track with her friend.

He wants to see that ordinary afternoon very much.

Mum comes inside to get more thread.

“He may visit in the summer,” Ronan tells her.

“Good. Does he know when?”

“Not yet.”

“Then we can wait for the dates.”

She looks at the letter. “And the birthday?”

“He remembered.”

“I did too. What would you like for dinner?”

Ronan thinks. “Noodles. The ones Dad made.”

Mum smiles. “He will need to start before dinner, then.”

Dad comes home later. Ronan tells him about the noodles and the possible visit.

“Which is first?” Dad asks.

“The noodles.”

“Then I can manage the first thing.”

“Will you be home for dinner?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. I have told Mr Sun. I will leave at the usual time that day.”

Ronan nods. Dad puts his work bag away.

After dinner, Ronan takes out a clean sheet. He starts an answer to Leo with the running day.

Anna finished all four. I got there for the last two. She started slowly and kept going.

He adds the family delivery and the bike ride. Then he stops before the summer part. He does not have Leo's dates either.

Ronan leaves room to finish the letter after his birthday. He folds Leo's reply and puts it in his drawer.

At the door, Mum asks him to bring in the last piece of cloth. He carries it carefully, away from the rough wall.

The evening air is still warm. Thursday feels close now. He leaves the new page beside his book and goes to help Dad clear the kitchen table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

manage＝设法完成、安排得来；possible＝可能的；remember＝记得；leave room＝留出空间。

## 理解问题

1. Leo是否已经知道跑步活动结果？为什么？
2. 夏天的回访是不是已经确定了日期？Ronan为生日选了什么普通快乐？

## 读句子

**He folds Leo's reply and puts it in his drawer.**

拆开看：He / folds Leo's reply / and puts it in his drawer.

他／折好Leo的回信／放进自己的抽屉。
